title: Better Vine
description: A resource pack that makes vines more visible
body:
# About
![With the resource pack enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6564094a3eb0d32d742d84e5b146ae6479bc5213.png)
* Improves vine visibility with adjusted shape and color  
* Vines have different front and back textures
* This resource pack was made for manhunt

# Require
[![Requires Polytone Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e82d3fb3564d63776112b8f8864d6ca036d7e4d.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone)
* This resource pack requires the [Polytone mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone)
* This mod is required for the resource pack to have biome-based colors.
